label: Bible Study
prompt: Feed the _____ of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verse: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
note: Peter, once told 'Feed my sheep,' now passes the charge on to church elders.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Give _____ unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verse: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
note: The first words of the psalm David gave to Asaph the day the ark came home: give thanks.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there appeared unto them _____ tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
verse: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them.
note: 'Cloven' means split — the tongues like fire at Pentecost were divided, one settling on each of them.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither _____ nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verse: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
note: Agur's prayer: not too poor to be tempted to steal, not too rich to forget God — just daily bread.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men _____; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
verse: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.
note: Seven hundred 'lefthanded' Benjamites could sling a stone at a hair and not miss. Ehud was a lefthanded Benjamite too (3:15).
